description: This file defines a React component for listing and managing event types, including features like search, pagination, editing, duplicating, deleting, and embedding event types. It also manages context for search terms and integrates with various hooks and external components.

classes.name: InfiniteTeamsTab
classes.description: React component for displaying event types within a specific group, with infinite scrolling and search capabilities.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Component for rendering individual event type items with actions and details.

classes.name: InfiniteEventTypeList
classes.description: Component for rendering a list of event types with pagination, reordering, and management actions.

classes.name: CreateFirstEventTypeView
classes.description: Component for displaying a prompt to create the first event type when none exist.

classes.name: CTA
classes.description: Component for rendering search input and create button for event types.

classes.name: EmptyEventTypeList
classes.description: Component for displaying an empty state when no event types are found.

classes.name: InfiniteScrollMain
classes.description: Main component managing the display of event type groups, tabs, and dialogs.

classes.name: EventTypesCTA
classes.description: Component providing call-to-action for creating new event types based on user permissions.

classes.name: EventTypesPage
classes.description: Main page component for listing and managing event types, handling onboarding redirection and profile banners.

methods.name: useSearchContext
methods.description: Custom hook to access search term context.

methods.name: moveEventType
methods.description: Function to reorder event types within the list.

methods.name: deleteEventTypeHandler
methods.description: Function to handle deletion of an event type.

methods.name: openDuplicateModal
methods.description: Function to open the duplicate event type modal with URL parameters.
